rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we get through...?! Where's everyone..."
Touya: "We can't go back... So we're on our own now..."
Celica: "...I feel like someone arranged this..."
Touya: "If we can't go back, we've got to go forward."
Celica: "Let's be careful."
Touya: "Yeah."
Celica: "!! What... Is this the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's absurdly huge..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Directly into my head..."
Celica: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Celica: "Hear what?"
Touya: "I see...
Someone's speaking straight into my head right now."
Celica: "...That's an illogical phenomenon. But..."
Voice: (Someone has finally made it here...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, of course... What about this?
Isn't this a voice you recognize?)
Touya: (This is... Debish!?
You survived?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so funny?!)
Voice: (...Oh, excuse me.
Your thinking was so simplistic.
I was indeed inside him at one time, but I am not him.
Let's see... You may regard me
as something like that Lin Karma person
who accompanied you.)
Touya: (Disembodied consciousness that can exist without its body...)
Voice: (I am something purer and more essential, however.
Anyway, you've done very well.
I never thought that failure back then would have this result.)
Touya: (Back then... Don't tell me, 109 years ago...)
Voice: (That's right. I thought it would work...
But it brought forth a talent like you,
so perhaps it was not a mistake in the end.
They too did well for me.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
Each of them served me devotedly...)
Touya: (Just what are you after?)
Voice: (...You humans of the Solar System were truly
amusing creatures.
You can sacrifice your own kind without a second thought
for your desires, yet also try to save them...
It is most intriguing.
Watching your actions never bores me.
What was the term...? Ah,
would you call it 'entertainment' in your world?)
Touya: ('Entertainment'... You say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
Your struggles, your suffering... And your defiance, even then.
Nothing beats the pleasure
of a true battle with life and death at stake... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why the hell would you do that?!)
Voice: (Why? What an amusing thing to ask.
Because I am bored, of course.
For us, freed from time's shackles and able
even to create the future,
daily life is nothing but boredom.
So chosen beings such as myself
pass the time enjoying games like this.
Yes, risking the extinction of our own existence.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
For a reason like that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever simply placed yourself
in the aimless flow of time?
Nothing changes. The same time just keeps passing...
I too accepted that as natural at first.
I never even questioned it. But that was wrong.
When I watched humans on distant worlds
far beyond our galaxy, living their momentary lives,
they gave my empty heart a time of fulfillment.
They risked their lives, fought, and won, showing me
life's brilliance. The exhilaration I experienced
was understood by only a very few.
But that is of no consequence.
Right now, I am spending my time most richly.)
Touya: (I won't forgive you... Playing with human lives
to pass the time... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, yes. Keep coming with that spirit.
You hold humanity's future in your hands now.
Or that Rayblade you are piloting does.)
Touya: (What does that mean?)
Voice: (Since recorded history began, whenever humanity faced peril,
there has always been something to stop it, hasn't there?
At times a person, at times a sword,
and at times an idea...
Something appropriate to that age saved humanity.
Have you never wondered why
such convenient things happen?)
Touya: (D-don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, me. Those idiots of Lin Karma
seem to have believed they sealed Vorlia away.
But I could have left a place like that whenever I chose.
I didn't because there was simply no need.
And above all, that spared me their interference.
It was convenient for playing with you humans,
who patch up surface appearances and never learn anything fundamental.
...So this time, that Rayblade is
the 'key' that will save humanity.
The only thing that can stop this Vorlia.
That is why you were able to reach me...)
Touya: (...But since we're alive here now,
doesn't that mean you were beaten before?)
Voice: (No. They failed. They could not even
reach me... So they were all buried in history,
their ambitions unfinished...)
Touya: (...Then I'll end it this time.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager must be made
on equal terms. Keeping myself somewhere safe
would deny me true enjoyment.
You might call it suspense.
It magnifies the enjoyment many times over.
That is why I have given you this chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (Destroy this 'Core' with Rayblade,
and Vorlia and I will lose the ability to sustain our existence and vanish.
Then this world will be saved...
Hehehe... Now then, may I get started?)
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...Touya wouldn't tell a lie like that..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "Touya...? Hey, what's wrong?"
Touya: "...Huh? I was talking just now..."
Celica: "Talking...? When? It's only been
a few jiki since you fell silent."
Touya: "......? I see..."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do things like this as well.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Well then, shall we begin...?)
Yamato: "M-meow, what's that?!"
Celica: "A black Rayblade... What's going on?!"
Touya: "...Let's go."
Celica: "...Huh?"
Touya: "If we defeat it, it'll all end."
Celica: "I don't understand, but all right."
Touya: "Sorry."
Celica: "Leave the support to me!"
Touya: "Yeah. I trust you."
Voice: (...Hm? You have damage...
It won't be interesting unless you fight
at full strength... Very well.)
Celica: "What?! How? The damage... It's being repaired..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, amuse me!)
Touya: (Let's end this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehehe... Very well.
Then put an end to everything with your own hands...)
Touya: (I don't need you to tell me that!)
Voice: (Good. You entertain me quite well...
But it seems you've reached your limit...
Well, I had excellent pawns moving for me
this time. It was rather enjoyable... But
it is time to say farewell...)
Voice: (...So you have disappointed me...
You had done well up to this point...
Still, I had excellent pawns moving for me
this time. It was rather enjoyable... So
I will erase you instantly, without suffering...)
Touya: "Damn......"
Celica: "Touya..."
Voice: (What?! I-impossible... You...!)
Kasumi: "Touya!"
Touya: "Kasumi!"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're having trouble."
Arthur: "It's unfair
for you to take all the best parts yourselves, isn't it?"
Celica: "Everyone..."
Aurelie: "We somehow made it in time."
Fain: "Princess! Now that we're here, you can rest easy!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "We're better off all together, aren't we?"
Ai: "Everyone together for the finale. That's the way it goes!"
Gen: "I'll look cool at least for the finale!"
Melvi: "I'm here too!"
Voice: (Why... How could you break that barrier...?)
Rayfon: (You'd do well not to underestimate this world's people.
These humans who have established their 'individuality.'
Each is weak alone, but when they connect,
they show more strength than you anticipate...
That is the distinguishing trait of these humans.
Being imperfect, they seek to make up for it
through cooperation with others. That produces
an unpredictable power that numbers alone cannot explain.
Trust, friendship, love... It takes many forms.
Do you know what it is called?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (It is called... 'bonds.'
You believe in yourselves alone and trust no one.
No one relies on you, and you love no one.
I doubt beings like you could understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Fascinating! It grows ever more fascinating!
Very well. You too shall have the right
to participate in this wager!)
Voice: (...!? Why?! Why won't they come out?!)
Rishuna: (It's no use. I have sealed off this space.
You cannot summon anything now.)
Voice: (Damn...)
Valga: (It's time to bring this to an end.)
Voice: (I seem... to have underestimated you a little...
But this is also within my power...)
Clovis: "What?! What's happening...?"
Arthur: "Illusions...? No, that's wrong..."
Xiujian: "...So the final foe is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the delightful banquet begin!!)
Celica: "...A drawn-out battle would put us at a disadvantage..."
Touya: "Celica... I might try something a bit reckless...
Will you come with me?"
Celica: "...Why would you ask me that?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "Do you need to hear my answer to know?"
Touya: "...You're right. Sorry.
...Celica, let's go."
Celica: "Yes! As far as it takes."
Clovis: "Th-this is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Touya: "...Here we go!!"
Celica: "Everyone!"
Kasumi: "Touya!"
Fain: "Princess!!"
Clovis: "Are you both safe?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It appears the battle has been decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here as well, you know..."
Voice: (...Well done... You've given me considerable enjoyment...)
Touya: (It's over.)
Voice: (Hehehehehe... Indeed...
But that does not mean everything is over...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I shall disappear, yes.
But if you do not eliminate the Core,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...It was quite enjoyable...
It isn't so bad to experience destruction... after all...)
Touya: (W-wait! How do I make the Core disappear?!)
Voice: (...I told you that Rayblade was the key...
You must work out the method yourself...)
Touya: (The key... Myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... I regret that I cannot
see it through to the end, but I wish you success... Farewell...)
Celica: "Huh? Wh-what...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the meow...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even give me time to think..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "...Listen to me."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you switching to transmit mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Celica: "..."
Yamato: "...Celica? Why are you stopping me?"
Celica: "Let's leave it to Touya. Trust him."
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core.
But this Rayblade is the only thing that can do that.
So I want you to return ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell is going on?!"
Touya: "...I know I'm being selfish
saying this after coming all this way.
But it isn't because I don't believe in you.
I want you to go back because I believe in you, because I trust you.
Let me feel reassured that there's a place I can return to,
a place I have to return to..."
Clovis: "Hey, after we've come this far, you can't say that.
We're sticking with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... You think we'll just obey
if you tell us to return? I'm not so low
that I'd push everything onto a comrade and walk away alone."
Arthur: "How cold of you... I'll accompany you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'll stay with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should accept reality calmly.
There is nothing we can do as we are now.
It's frustrating... But that is the truth.
We shouldn't make things harder for him.
If we truly believe in him, if we are truly his comrades,
we should entrust this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you have to honor
your promise to come back."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, never mind.
It's just a short parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to take care of things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "......I will not say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to take care of things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah. I won't either."
Arthur: "...Take care..."
Fain: "......Damn!"
Touya: "I'm counting on you to take care of things back there."
Fain: "...A-all right! But you mustn't die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Touya... I'll be waiting.
So I won't say goodbye..."
Touya: "Yeah. Just wait a little while."
Kasumi: "Okay. I understand...... Be safe."
Touya: "...I'll be going."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Celica: "...You intend to use Rayblade itself."
Touya: "You figured it out."
Celica: "That's what it would take
to destroy a mass like that.
But... Rayblade will be destroyed."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Celica: "But if I'm with you, I'm not afraid.
Even if we..."
Touya: "...Let's stop there.
If you think about bad things, you'll really bring them on.
All we have to do is what we believe in."
Celica: "You're right..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hm?"
Celica: "Can I... come over there?"
Touya: "...Y-yeah."
Yamato: "What?! What about piloting?"
Touya: "It'll be all right, won't it?"
Celica: "Yes. The way we are now, with our feelings connected,
we should be able to control it better if we feel each other close by."
Celica: "...There we go.
...It's still embarrassing."
Celica: "But we can't give up here.
Maybe we're here for this very moment.
Touya, let's go."
Touya: "...Yeah."
Touya: "...Full power. Disengage all control systems..."
Celica: "Touya..."
Touya: "...Here we go!"
Touya: "Uooooooooh!!"

review_batches.context: Read all335 rows, Kasumi353/Aurelie343 and earlier Ai finale for separate-route context. Celica suspects orchestration; concealed Voice speaks only to Touya, borrows Debish's voice and describes its pastime/past involvement.
review_batches.decisions: No source-order chronology imposed. Keep Celica's suspicion as suspicion, source Voice label and mental parentheses. Claims of inhabiting Debish, similarity to a Lin Karma being,109 years, creating futures and limited understanding by others remain attributed. No inserted identity or named companion. Preserve interrupted questions, lists and deliberate noun phrases.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o0092d.p01.l08: Only a few, not a guessed majority.

Threats and manipulative enjoyment stay harsh; outcomes conditional rather than one chronology.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Voice departs without a solution, Celica stops Yamato's interruption, Touya asks others to return and Rayfon urges trust; farewells and Celica infers the use of Rayblade's mass.
review_batches.decisions: Make help direction explicit in repeated back-there entrustments and the return-place request. Promise/effort is not a guaranteed return. Celica's mass-based inference does not supply real engineering instructions or a runtime unit identity. Her interrupted possible-fate thought remains uncompleted; Touya's bad-thoughts warning is personal reassurance, not narrator causation.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o02618.l02: Team returns ahead of Rayblade occupants.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o026a2.l05: Touya asks assurance of a place to return.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o027b5.l02: Xiujian refuses to leave Touya with burden.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o0281e.l00: Short complaint plus explicit I commitment.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03c.o02e03.l01: Touya's reassurance/superstitious thought, not objective causality.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Celica comes closer, explains her expectation of synchronized control, steels herself and joins the full-power charge.
review_batches.decisions: Nonexplicit closeness and feelings remain ordinary affection with no sexual additions. Better control is her expectation, not a proved technical mechanic. Generic full-power/control-system commands are fictional scene speech, with no added operational parameters. Member ends at charge, without a stated survival/death outcome.
